artworks.title: Madonna and Child Appearing to a Supplicant
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Kurt Meissner
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, a woman holding a child while standing on a crescent moon. The woman has loose hair, wears a long garment, and a crown with stars. The child points upward. To the left is a kneeling figure, wearing a dress with curled hair. The background is simple.

artworks.title: Courtyard of a Swiss Country House
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Kurt Meissner
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a rustic wooden building surrounded by trees. The sketch is done in a loose, organic style with light pencil strokes. There are details on the building to show texture and depth. The scene is monochrome, using shading to convey light and shadow. Stone steps and figures near the building are softly rendered. In the distance, there are more trees and less defined structures.

artworks.title: Fortified Castle Above a Narrow Valley
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Kurt Meissner
artworks.description: The image features a pencil drawing of a landscape from an elevated perspective. A building stands on a cliff to the left, overlooking a deep ravine with lush vegetation. The ravine is characterized by rocky walls and trees, creating a textured landscape. The horizon line is high in the composition, adding depth to the scene. The drawing shows soft, careful pencil strokes for outlines and shading, with a monochromatic color palette of graphite gray tones.

artworks.title: A Terraced Garden by a Villa
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Kurt Meissner
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a landscape. The horizon is high on the image, with trees dominating the center. Closest to us are bushes and shrubs, leading to a stone wall. In the background are more trees surrounding a rectangular building. The sketch is monochrome, emphasizing the natural scenery.

artworks.title: Italian Mountain Landscape
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Kurt Meissner
artworks.description: This image depicts a landscape drawn from an elevated perspective overlooking rolling terrain. The mountain range occupies the upper half of the image, with subtle peaks blending into one another. The brushstrokes are fine, with light pencil lines outlining the landscape. Close to us, the lines are slightly darker, hinting at a slope leading towards a small village or fortress structure settled beyond. The structure is detailed, positioned on rising ground among hills. The composition is in a monochrome palette, with variations in pencil intensity signaling depth and texture. The image conveys a serene depiction of a mountainous landscape with a touch of human presence.

artworks.title: Camel
artworks.medium: red and black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a camel with a partially finished saddle and load. The drawing depicts a camel as the main subject, with a focus on its head and upper torso. It is rendered using a combination of pencil and red chalk, providing a sense of depth and texture to the camel's fur and features. The camel is equipped with a saddle and some items attached to its back, including a cylindrical container and an outline of its load. The background and lower part of the camel are faintly sketched, suggesting the unfinished nature of the work, while the detailing in the head and saddle area is more developed. Overall, the drawing reflects a blend of precision in certain areas and looseness in others, emphasizing the artist's focus on the camel and its equipment.

artworks.title: Fighting Cock
artworks.medium: red and black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two rooster heads. The drawing depicts an upper and lower rooster head with intricate lines. The artist uses black and red chalk to highlight the texture of the feathers and contours of the roosters' faces. The lines convey the movement and direction of the feathery plumes. Both roosters display a focused gaze with emphasis on the detailed eye area. Minimal shading is used to draw attention to the expressive lines and textures.

artworks.title: Panoramic Landscape along the Rhine
artworks.medium: black chalk with yellow, brown, and gray wash and touches of gum arabic on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from an elevated viewpoint with a broad perspective of the countryside. The horizon is in the upper third of the composition with hills, a cluster of buildings, and a church steeple. The brushstrokes are loose and flowing, creating a soft texture for the clouds in the sky. The color palette is muted and earthy, with browns and grays. The rolling hills in the foreground are dark brown, fading into lighter shades in the distance.

artworks.title: Profile of a Man Wearing Spectacles
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's profile view, facing left. His facial features include a nose, mustache, and small, wire-framed glasses. His hair is short and neatly combed. He is wearing a light-colored shirt with a collar, and a darker jacket is visible on his shoulder. The background is plain. In the lower right corner, the artist's signature, "K. Boese," is visible.

artworks.title: Pharoah Perishing in the Red Sea
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals engaged in an outdoor scene. A man is in the center with his arm extended, accompanied by others around him, some standing, others seated or crouching near objects like a bust and a pedestal. The background shows cloudy skies and distant figures positioned on the horizon. The use of lines and shadows enhances the textures and depths, capturing a sense of action and communication amidst a natural setting.

artworks.title: Eleanora, Wife of Ferdinand II
artworks.artist: Pieter van Sompel after Pieter Claesz Soutman
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of a woman from the chest up, framed within an oval decorated with intricate floral and foliage patterns. The woman is facing forward, showing her facial features. She has a smooth forehead, arched eyebrows, slightly turned eyes, a straight nose, and closed lips with a subtle curve. Her hair is neatly styled up, possibly held by a piece of jewelry, adorned with a small headpiece. She wears an ornate ruff around her neck and a detailed bodice with embroidery or jewels. The background features an ornate framework of carved design, including leaves, flowers, and swirls.

artworks.title: La Fête nationale au Boulevard Clichy (National Holiday on the Boulevard de Clichy)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, foul-bite, and soft-ground etching in blue, red, black, and gold on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting a lively street scene in a city. The central focus is a bustling urban street adorned with flags, featuring a streetlamp. Various people are engaged in day-to-day activities such as walking, strolling with pets, and conversing. Their faces and identities are not depicted. The background shows architectural elements and a sky with clouds. There is a decorative border with intricate illustrations resembling etchings around the main image, adding to the historical and cultural context. The style is reminiscent of James Jacques Joseph Tissot, known for detailed and vivid depictions of contemporary scenes.

artworks.title: Lago Maggiore
artworks.medium: brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Bequest of Lore Heinemann in memory of her husband, Rudolf J. Heinemann
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a town across a body of water, including architectural outlines and mountains in the background. The drawing uses precise lines to depict the scene, with a limited color palette of natural tones and muted sepia ink. Figures in boats and a person standing near the water are also depicted.

artworks.title: Studies of Lago Maggiore and and the Entrance to a Palazzo
artworks.medium: brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Bequest of Lore Heinemann in memory of her husband, Rudolf J. Heinemann
artworks.description: The image displays a side view of a wide riverscape or coastal scene with a large, block-like building on the right. The horizon is low, with faint mountains in the distance. Boats with figures are depicted in the water near the building, suggesting activity. The sketchy, linear brushstrokes give the drawing an unfinished look, and the color palette is monochrome using light brown paper and dark brown ink.

artworks.title: Königsee with the Cliffs of St. Bartholomëe
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Bequest of Lore Heinemann in memory of her husband, Rudolf J. Heinemann
artworks.description: The image shows a scene by a lake. Cows, a white horse, a man in a wide-brimmed hat riding the horse, and two children playing in the water are present. A mountain range is in the background, with faint clouds in the sky. On the right, there is a small settlement with buildings and a church near the water's edge. The artist uses detailed brushstrokes, especially noticeable in the mountains and animals. The color palette consists of muted blues, greys, earthy tones, and hints of warmer hues in the sky.

artworks.title: Venus and Adonis
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of cherubic figures in a forest setting. The drawing features cherubs engaged in various poses, interacting with animals like dogs and a wild boar. The landscape is dense with trees, foliage, and animals, with some cherubs appearing among the nature. Delicate lines and detailed shading create depth and texture within the scene, highlighting the playful atmosphere of the forest environment.

artworks.title: Saint John the Baptist and Saint Onuphrius
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-length male figures standing in a natural setting. The figure on the left has curly hair and a beard, wearing a long robe with a rope around his waist. He holds a lamb and a staff, with a contemplative expression. The figure on the right has a long beard and curly hair, wearing a draped garment leaving one shoulder bare. He holds a tablet or book, seemingly explaining something. Both figures stand near a large tree trunk amidst vegetation. In the background, there are rolling hills, trees, a cloudy sky, and distant ships, creating a rural landscape scene.

artworks.title: A Man Writing at a Table
artworks.medium: mezzotint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated at a table with his upper body visible. He is leaning forward with both arms resting on the table, engaging in a task with his hands. His facial expression appears focused, with slightly furrowed brows and lips pressed together. The man has curly, shoulder-length hair and wears a long-sleeved garment with a layered collar. Two small circular ink pots are on the table next to him. In the background, there is a plain, dark backdrop, highlighting the man and the table in the foreground. A cloth or shawl is partially visible on the left side of the table.

artworks.title: Garden Capriccio with Antique Ruins
artworks.medium: watercolor and black ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips in memory of Neil Phillips
artworks.description: The image displays classical ruins in an oval format. The perspective is slightly elevated, showing aged architectural structures dominating the scene. Details of columns, arches, and a distant domed building are visible. The brushstrokes accentuate stone textures. Earthy tones dominate the color palette, with hints of blues and grays. Trees with dark foliage are present, alongside figures in period clothing engaged in various activities near us.

artworks.title: The Stoning of Saint Stephen
artworks.medium: pen and ink and watercolor on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles and Ilona Mack in memory of Mary Dirnberger Sundbeck
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of figures in a dynamic and dramatic scene. The central part of the image is dominated by three figures. The painting shows two individuals raising large stones as if they are about to throw them, and another figure is kneeling or falling. The colors in the painting are soft and muted, with tones of pink, blue, and earth tones used to portray the figures. On the right side, a group of other figures are seated or standing, observing the event. They are dressed in flowing garments, and their expressions convey focus and concern. The background includes architectural elements and trees, suggesting an outdoor setting. The style of the painting emphasizes muscular human forms and expression, reminiscent of Mannerist art.

artworks.title: I Am Starving
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Roy and Cecily Langdale Davis in honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: This is an image of four figures in a scene filled with various elements. The characters are depicted in different actions, with a backdrop of a crowded cityscape or structures. One person is dressed in period clothing with a top hat, another wears a large hat, and both interact with the other two figures. In the center, a figure holds a sign saying "I Am Starving" and holds an object resembling a musical instrument. Below, a seated figure looks up with a pensive expression while holding a basket or book, and small animals may be seen consuming spilled contents on the ground. The drawing is detailed with a cross-hatching technique, creating a textured atmosphere.

artworks.title: Mrs. Pelham
artworks.artist: William Dickinson after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.medium: mezzotint in brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Paul Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing outdoors in a full-length portrait. She is slightly positioned to the side, with her body leaning as if distributing food from a basket. The woman has delicate facial features and an 18th-century updo. She wears a long dress with floral patterns, a sash, and lace sleeves, and holds a basket. The background shows a lush landscape with trees, a farm setting, houses, and a path. There are several birds at her feet.

artworks.title: A Tigress
artworks.medium: mezzotint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 48.1 x 58.4 cm (18 15/16 x 23 in.)
sheet: 53.5 x 60.3 cm (21 1/16 x 23 3/4 in.)
overall (mat size): 66 x 86.4 cm (26 x 34 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Paul Mellon Fund
artworks.description: This is a painting of a tiger in a natural setting. The tiger is lying down on foliage and rocks, displaying its distinct striped fur pattern. Its gaze is calm and direct. The background is dark, emphasizing the tiger and its surroundings, which include leaves and rocks.

artworks.title: Colonel St. Leger
artworks.medium: mezzotint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Paul Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing in a relaxed pose leaning against a horse. The man is looking to the left, while the horse stands calmly beside him. The man is dressed in an 18th-century military uniform with various details including epaulettes, a sash, trousers, and boots. He also wears a waistcoat, cravat, and holds a hat in his left hand. The man is gently holding the horse's rein with his right hand, and a sword is visible on his belt. The horse is adorned with a bridle and saddle, standing in a countryside setting with trees and cloudy skies in the background.
